bill_title: State Conclusive Land Titling & Title Indemnity Fund Act, 2026
key_statutory_clauses: Section 4: Establishment of the Land Titling Authority (LTA) under an officer not below the rank of Principal Secretary.
Section 9: Creation of the Statutory Title Indemnity Fund to compensate bona fide owners against administrative errors.
Section 14: Final Record of Title shall be conclusive evidence of ownership with statutory state guarantee.
cabinet_summary: Replaces presumptive colonial title deeds with state-guaranteed conclusive ownership, eliminating 68% of civil court boundary litigations.

bill_title: Model Agricultural Land Leasing & Digital Tenancy Protection Act
key_statutory_clauses: Section 3: Legalization of land leasing without loss of ownership rights for cultivating or absentee landholders.
Section 7: Automatic inclusion of tenant farmers for institutional Kisan Credit Card (KCC) loans and crop insurance (PMFBY).
Section 11: Summary eviction procedures through Revenue Courts within 60 days upon lease term expiry.
cabinet_summary: Unlocks 25 million hectares of fallow land by protecting landholder ownership while guaranteeing institutional credit to tenant cultivators.
